##### Project general facts

Ramada Residences by Wyndham in Dubai South is a premium serviced residential project by Lincoln Star Real Estate Development, created to combine refined design with the comfort and service of an international hospitality brand. The development offers fully serviced studios, 1-bedroom and 2-bedroom apartments designed for an elegant, effortless lifestyle.

Residents can enjoy an impressive collection of leisure and wellness amenities, including a swimming pool, Jacuzzi, sauna, BBQ area, sports lounge, gym, jogging track, multipurpose room, kids’ playroom, open activity area, sun terrace and sky lounge. The experience is further enhanced by hotel-style services such as 24/7 reception, concierge, valet, in-room dining, housekeeping and other thoughtful services that make everyday life exceptionally convenient.

Every residence is fully furnished, fully fitted and fully serviced, offering a ready-to-enjoy home with stylish interiors and a warm, sophisticated atmosphere. Elegant wood finishes, soft neutral tones, modern lighting, fitted kitchens and carefully selected furniture create beautiful spaces where comfort, functionality and contemporary design come together seamlessly.

##### Location description and benefits

Dubai South stands as one of the city's most visionary and rapidly evolving districts, offering an exceptional environment where modern living meets unparalleled opportunity and connectivity. This dynamic neighbourhood has been master-planned to create a seamless blend of residential, commercial, and leisure spaces, ensuring that every convenience is always within effortless reach. The community's strategic position and forward-thinking design make it an increasingly desirable destination for those seeking both lifestyle excellence and long-term value.

Life within Dubai South is defined by its perfect balance of tranquillity and accessibility, where serene residential streets coexist with vibrant commercial hubs and world-class amenities. The neighbourhood's welcoming atmosphere and reputation as a community of choice for discerning individuals make it an attractive destination for families, professionals, and investors alike. Exceptional connectivity places the vibrant heart of Dubai within effortless reach, while the surrounding environment offers a peaceful retreat from the urban bustle.

The surroundings of Dubai South offer a peaceful retreat from the urban bustle, while major road networks provide seamless access to the city's most prestigious destinations, ensuring that business, education, and leisure are always perfectly balanced. This distinguished address truly offers the best of both worlds, combining the serenity of suburban living with the dynamic allure of a global metropolis, making Dubai South an ideal location for those seeking a unique and unparalleled living experience.
